title: Govee’s portable smart lamp is down to one of its best prices to date
summary: Because it’s cordless, the lamp is surprisingly versatile. Despite being small and light enough to carry from room to room, the Table Lamp Classic offers many of the same smart lighting features found on Govee’s bigger lamps.
